title: Register as a responsible supplier before selling in-scope electrical equipment
what: As the responsible supplier (manufacturer or importer) of in-scope electrical equipment, sell it only once registered as a responsible supplier, with each level 2 or 3 type also registered, and each item meeting the relevant standard.

sources.title: Electrical Safety Regulation 2013 (Qld)
sources.publisher: Queensland Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A responsible supplier of a type of level 1 in-scope electrical equipment must not sell an item of the type unless— (a) the responsible supplier is a registered responsible supplier

sources.title: Electrical Safety Regulation 2013 (Qld)
sources.publisher: Queensland Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A responsible supplier of a type of level 2 or 3 in-scope electrical equipment must not sell an item of the type unless— (a) the responsible supplier is a registered responsible supplier; and (b) the type is registered in relation to the responsible supplier

administration.who: National register of responsible suppliers (Electrical Equipment Safety System)
administration.note: Registration is by entry in the national register; the Queensland regulator under the Electrical Safety Act 2002 enforces the sale rules (not quoted).

sources.title: Electrical Safety Regulation 2013 (Qld)
sources.publisher: Queensland Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 123, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: A responsible supplier is registered if the supplier is recorded in the part of the national register that records registered responsible suppliers.
